title: Replacement Vehicle Credit Amount, Kessler GAP Plus Claims
content:
# Replacement Vehicle Credit Amount, Kessler GAP Plus Claims

**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — computation of the replacement vehicle credit.**

**The replacement purchase.** The replacement purchase is the holder's most recently signed group purchase deal: the deal whose vehicle price was charged last (of two charged the same day, the one recorded first), where that deal stands in contracted status. A credit is figured under this computation only toward such a purchase; toward a replacement in any other status the credit is the replacement vehicle credit amount of the waiver's tier.

**The paid line.** The paid line is the waiver's most recent paid GAP balance line. A waiver with no paid GAP balance line on file receives no replacement vehicle credit, and a waiver whose tier replacement vehicle credit amount is 0.00 receives none.

**The credit.** The replacement vehicle credit starts from the replacement vehicle credit amount of the waiver's tier. The overpayment set-off is the total of the benefit reversal entries on the waiver's ledger. The credit already given is the total of the amounts on the waiver's replacement vehicle credit lines, a denied line carrying 0.00. The replacement vehicle credit is the starting credit less the overpayment set-off and less the credit already given, rounded half up to the cent and floored at 0.00.

| Record | Role in the credit |
|---|---|
| Tier replacement vehicle credit amount | Starting credit |
| Benefit reversal entries on the waiver's ledger | Overpayment set-off, subtracted |
| Replacement vehicle credit lines on the waiver's ledger | Credit already given, subtracted |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A waiver whose tier credit amount is 1,000.00 has one benefit reversal entry of 212.40 and no replacement vehicle credit line yet; the replacement deal stands contracted. The credit is 1,000.00 less 212.40 less 0.00, which is 787.60. With reversal entries totalling 1,040.00 the result would fall below zero and the credit is 0.00.
